$comment: The composable scaffold feature flags (D11). Single source of truth for both scripts/scaffold.mjs (materialization) and the scaffold_profile_valid deterministic plan gate (validation). The planner chooses a profile as part of the judged task plan; code materializes it. A flag not listed here is invalid.

flags.d1: Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) database with a migrations/ directory
flags.queues: Queue producer + consumer with a dead-letter queue
